messages:
Leah - People Ops: Quick idea 1: run a pilot for digital 'Spotlight' badges (little verified digital badges + a downloadable certificate) that get issued automatically when a spot award is approved. Less shipping, faster recognition. Thoughts?

Sam - Eng Infra: Love it. Two infra asks: 1) how do we want badges surfaced (Slack profile, verified in internal portal, public LinkedIn export?) 2) need an API trigger from HRIS.

Maya - Talent: We can design 3 badge tiers (spark, impact, steward). Also happy to own copy for cert emails.

Aisha - HRBP: Need opt-in/opt-out because some folks prefer not to have public-facing badges. Also privacy review for what metadata is stored on a badge.

Priya - Security: SSO + SAML attributes required. We should avoid including manager notes or award reasons on the badge itself. We can sign badges with a short UUID and verification endpoint.

Kat - People Ops: Could we have a short animated GIF variant for Slack and static PNG for certs? Also want a printable PDF certificate.

Leah - People Ops: Goal: pilot with Eng + Product spot-award recipients, roll out company-wide in Q3. Pilot window mid-July.

ops-bot: FYI: Any workflow touching HR data needs HRIS change request and infra review per policy-23.

Sam - Eng Infra: Technical approach proposal: 1) badge service (internal) issues signed badge token via OAuth client when HRIS webhook confirms award. 2) Badge meta stored in small DB (employee id, badge id, issued_at, revoked flag). 3) Endpoints: /verify/<id> and /badge/<id>.png. 4) Slack integration via app-managed profile_pic or app message with gif.

Priya - Security: Approve architecture with conditions: encryption at rest, short retention for raw HR payloads, revocation endpoint must be realtime. Also need threat model doc.

Maya - Talent: I'll prepare three mockups and sample cert text by next Tue (2024-07-16).

Aisha - HRBP: I'll add opt-in column to spot-award form and update manager flow. Also will coordinate with Legal on badge wording.

Leah - People Ops: Can we keep offline/printable option for people who want physical tokens later? Not necessary for pilot but good to note.

Kat - People Ops: I'll recruit two designers for small GIFs and 1 volunteer for editorial review on cert wording.

Sam - Eng Infra: Timeline estimate: 2 weeks for prototype endpoints + Slack app + sign/verify flow. Need one backend eng and one infra SRE. Can we get a small IC allocation?

Leah - People Ops: We can move a 0.2 FTE from People Ops and request 1 engineer from Eng Infra for 2 weeks.

Priya - Security: I'll schedule a short design review Wed. Add threat model checklist to the thread.

ops-bot: Reminder 1: schedule a change request in HRIS for the webhook before dev work starts.

Maya - Talent: Mockups link: https://tiny.redwood/spotlight-ui (internal).

Aisha - HRBP: Updated spot-award form draft: add 'digital badge opt-in' checkbox and 'certificate delivery preference' (email / download / physical).

Sam - Eng Infra: I'll spin up a prototype repo and share an RFC by Fri.

Leah - People Ops: Action items: Sam - prototype RFC by Fri; Maya - mockups Tue; Aisha - form update + legal check by end of week; Priya - security review Wed; Kat - design volunteers.

Kat - People Ops: I'll add volunteer names in the sheet and book 2x 1-hour sessions for GIFs.

Leah - People Ops: If anyone has concerns about recognition gamification or unintended incentives, DM me. We want this to be meaningful, not points-chasing.

Priya - Security: Noted. Also recommend a short FAQ and a support path for revocation requests.

Leah - People Ops: Great. Closing the thread for now; will post RFC link when Sam shares. Thanks! :sparkles:
